title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, stop recording a drafting model when the resolver failed o
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, stop recording a drafting model when the resolver failed over to a different provider, so a compose is never graded against a model that did not produce its text.

Replace this line, which occurs exactly once:
  lastDraftModel = String((j as { model_selection?: { selected?: unknown } })?.model_selection?.selected ?? "");

with exactly:
  lastDraftModel = (j as { fallback_from?: unknown })?.fallback_from
    ? ""
    : String((j as { model_selection?: { selected?: unknown } })?.model_selection?.selected ?? "");

Why: the resolver assigns model_selection once from the selection metadata and never reassigns model_selection.selected, so that field names the arm the bandit NOMINATED. When the chosen provider is unavailable the resolver serves the completion from a different client and returns fallback_from naming the original. Measured over three hours: nine anthropic 401 authentication errors and thirteen cooldowns, with claude-haiku-4-5 repeatedly nominated and repeatedly falling back to google/gemini-2.5-flash. The visible consequence is that claude-haiku currently shows a better drafting score than gemini despite apparently never having served a drafting completion, because gemini's penalties were recorded against it.

This uses the signal the response already provides: when fallback_from is present a failover happened, so no model is recorded and the compose simply goes ungraded rather than mis-graded. That deliberately trades a few observations for correct labels, which is the right trade for a learning signal - a wrong label is worse than a missing one.

This changes one assignment. It declares nothing, alters no control flow, and cannot change any verdict. The variable j is already in scope. The replacement does not contain the anchor, so applying it twice is a no-op.
